title: Payment API failing again
description: Customers are unable to complete payments and the API is returning HTTP 500 errors.
resolution: Renewed the certificate, deployed it to the Payment API instances, and restarted the service.
lessons: Verify certificate expiry and deployment across all Payment API instances after renewal.

title: Payment API failing again
description: Payment requests are returning HTTP 500 errors again.
rootCause: The Payment API certificate expired again, causing TLS failures and HTTP 500 errors on the /payments endpoint.
resolution: Renewed the Payment API certificate and restarted the Payment API service. Verified that payment requests were successful after the renewal.
lessons: Check the Payment API certificate expiration date first during future 500-error incidents. Maintain an automated certificate-expiry check and verify renewal before the certificate expires.

title: Payment API 500 errors
description: Customers could not complete payments. API returned HTTP 500 errors.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and restarted the payment service.
lessons: Check certificate expiry during payment API incidents.

title: Database connection failures
description: Order service intermittently failed to connect to PostgreSQL.
resolution: Fixed the connection leak and increased pool monitoring.
lessons: Check pool utilization and long-lived connections first.

title: High CPU on notification worker
description: Worker CPU reached 100% and message processing slowed down.
resolution: Fixed retry backoff logic and deployed a patch.
lessons: Inspect retry loops after unusual CPU spikes.
